contracts.order: Actual Slayer result/reaction -> target Race reference -> relevant identity selectors -> complete victim identity -> one ten-outcome count spin/reaction -> source-scoped Strength modifier -> Backstory.
contracts.referenceOnly: Victim identity is separate from the character. No victim race events, fixed grants, weapons, powers, mastery, army/follower counts, Size, Takeover, stats, titles or loot are executed/copied. Cosmic group reference never follows armor/ring/color reward wheels.
contracts.history: Use an independent usedVictimFamilyIds set across the victim tree. Target references do not consume/clear the character usedRaceFamilyIds. Target wrappers exclude already selected victim families before child draws; empty required pool is a configuration error.
contracts.probability: Target selectors keep canonical option weights/fixed ratios. Only the new Slayer count wheel uses delegated custom fixed likelihood profiles; canonical Vampire six-count odds remain unchanged. New count profiles have a 5% floor per outcome after normalization, total 100%; never clamp then renormalize below the floor. This count-only policy does not rebalance canonical identity selectors. Existing committed 1.0.0 count snapshots retain their original results/odds.
contracts.profileSelection: Difficulty is authored encounter-frequency metadata, never a main-stat score, power feat or lore guarantee. Last applicable subtype selects its profile; Siluman uses the single selected animal type. Anime NPC uses common regardless of genre; MC uses genre then Sci-fi identity role, without genre events.
contracts.composition: Skeleton/Zombie use their origin profile with minimum common; Symbiote uses host with minimum elite and no Takeover; Raksasa uses base +1 difficulty step with minimum apex, without Size; Hybrid uses hardest component +1 step. Cap at divine. One victim is the whole composite, not a count per component.
contracts.strength: Zero gives no modifier. Positive positions 1–3 +1, 4–6 +2, 7–9 +3 numeric Strength. Cap Slayer reward at +3; do not copy Vampire all-stat/Cursed rewards or infer extra loot from God/hero victims.
contracts.ledger: Register one flat Strength effect keyed by committed count spin/source. Project after immutable base Strength without numeric clamps; resume/re-render restores result/effect without redispatch, resampling or duplicate boost.
contracts.reaction: Each actual target/identity/count spin has its own reaction. Early beats reveal only committed target facts; reward known after count. Fixed bonus is not an extra spin or funny-result tag.
